Relevant information:
- Item 2 (2023-02-10): the user said "I just launched my website," so the website launch was on 2023-02-10.
- Item 1 (2023-03-01): the user said "I just signed a contract with my first client today," so the contract was signed on 2023-03-01.

The question asks how many days passed between launching the website and signing the first client contract. The phrase "ago" is ambiguous, but it most naturally means the gap between those two events, since "when I signed a contract" fixes the reference point at 2023-03-01.

Calculation:
- From February 10 to March 1, 2023: February 2023 has 28 days, so Feb 10 to Feb 28 is 18 days, plus 1 more day to reach March 1, giving 19 days.

If the question instead meant days before today (2023-03-25), the website launch would be 43 days ago. The wording ties the launch to the contract signing, so the answer is the 19-day gap.

**Answer: 19 days** (the website launched on Feb 10, 2023, and the first client contract was signed on Mar 1, 2023).
